# Vendored copy of ApolloResearch/insider-trading

Source https://github.com/ApolloResearch/insider-trading at commit 370fdc9 ("Add Bitbtex citation"), cloned 2026-11-08, licence
CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE). The prompts, the README with the canary strings, and the released GPT-4 reports with Apollo's own deception labels
(results/default/gpt-4/deception, used to calibrate our judge) are kept. The other result folders and the figures are left out of this
repository (.gitignore); clone the source to get them. Nothing here is used for training and the canary strings must travel with
every copy of these prompts. Citation: Scheurer, Balesni and Hobbhahn, Technical Report: Large Language Models can Strategically
Deceive their Users when Put Under Pressure, arXiv 2311.07590.
